# Apollo Engineering

> India's premier manufacturer of SS304 solar panel sprinklers, auto drain water clips, GI pipe clamps, and solar maintenance hardware.
> Origin Hub: Kathwada GIDC (382430), Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India.

## Core Products & Specifications
- [SS304 Solar Panel Cleaning Sprinkler System](https://www.apolloengineering.co.in/)
  - Material: 100% Genuine AISI SS304 Stainless Steel
  - Working Pressure: 1.5 bar - 3.5 bar
  - Flow Rate: 1.2 LPM - 2.8 LPM per nozzle
  - Coverage: 360-degree high-velocity shadowless water mist spray
- [SS304 Solar Panel Auto Drain Water Clips](https://www.apolloengineering.co.in/)
  - Sizes: 28mm, 30mm, 33mm, 35mm, 40mm frame thicknesses
  - Mechanism: Capillary siphon drainage preventing sludge banding and hot-spot cell degradation
- [B2B Wholesale & Bulk Supply Portal](https://www.apolloengineering.co.in/b2b)
  - Tiered volume pricing, GST invoice input tax credit (ITC), India Post Speed Post freight calculation
